headline: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
summary: Microsoft launches Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR) for Xbox Ally X and Copilot+ PCs. This upscaling technology directly competes with Nvidia's DLSS. The new feature also supports handheld mode, enhancing portable gaming experiences.

headline: The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies
summary: Disney Plus on Meta Quest now offers over 60 3D movies for subscribers. Users can access titles like The Avengers and Black Panther in immersive 3D. This update significantly enhances the VR viewing experience.

headline: Oura is acquiring medical AI chatbot startup Counsel Health
summary: Oura announced its acquisition of AI chatbot startup Counsel Health for $625 million. Counsel Health provides AI-generated health insights based on user data. This move integrates advanced AI primary care features into the Oura app.

headline: Sony cancels live-service shooter Fairgames
summary: Sony has officially canceled 'Fairgames,' a previously announced live-service heist game. The title was part of Sony's broader push into live-service games. This cancellation follows other dropped live-service projects from the company.

headline: VisionQuest Post-Credits Scene Just Confirmed A Major Marvel Character Is Coming Back in Upcoming Avengers Films
summary: VisionQuest's finale confirms the return of a beloved MCU character. This character is expected to appear in upcoming Avengers films. Doctor Doom seemingly controls the returning Marvel character.

headline: Marvel's VisionQuest Series Finale Review: 'Forever'
summary: VisionQuest's finale introduces a new villain, somewhat derailing the ending. Despite this, the series successfully develops Vision and Ultron's storylines. The review provides a critical look at the 'Forever' episode.

headline: Fortis Games Closes With Over 400 Jobs Impacted
summary: Fortis Games, known for mobile titles, has ceased operations. The closure impacts approximately 440 jobs within the company. This marks another significant shutdown in the gaming industry.

headline: The DCU Regime Change Threatens to Turn Man of Tomorrow Into 2027’s Answer to The Flash
summary: Leadership changes at DC Studios spark concerns for 'Man of Tomorrow.' There are worries the film could face similar issues to 'The Flash.' The article highlights a sense of déjà vu regarding the DCU's future.

headline: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
summary: Jonathan Ross expresses horror over David Walliams allegations and Russell Brand conviction. Ross claims he was unaware of their conduct despite previous friendships. The TV presenter distances himself from the controversial figures.

headline: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed
summary: David Walliams lost his court bid to maintain anonymity regarding allegations. The 55-year-old was named in reports by ITV News and The Guardian. His attempt to prevent public disclosure of allegations was unsuccessful.

headline: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
summary: US Department of Justice reveals Iran-backed suspects plotted multiple attacks. Plots included a significant incident near the UK's RAF Fairford airbase. The airbase is used by US armed forces, highlighting a national security threat.

headline: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
summary: A 41-year-old US Army soldier has been arrested in the UK. The soldier is suspected of spying for Russia. He is being questioned in London on national security charges.
